image_styles.label: 官方纹理
image_styles.note: 规则手册第 23 页俯视纹理，按内场边界裁切后重采样到 1500x1000，含烘焙阴影与官方地面标识

image_styles.label: CAD 配色
image_styles.note: STEP 三角化几何正交投影，按实测高度分级配色；几何与官方纹理版一致，便于看清墙体和隧道形体

source: RMUL2027_3V3_V1.0.0.stp (Creo AP214, exported 2026-09-22): inner field 12000 x 8000 mm measured from the CAD wall faces; outer frame 12600 x 8600 mm, wall thickness 300 mm, wall top 420 mm.

orientation.origin: bottom-left corner of the inner field
orientation.red_base: north-west; the red AP214 marking measures x 0.92-1.56 m, y 6.65-7.33 m at floor level
orientation.blue_base: south-east; the blue AP214 marking measures x 10.44-11.08 m, y 0.67-1.35 m at floor level

notes: Dimensions come from the CAD, not from measuring a screenshot.
Both image styles share the same 12x8 m frame and the same crop, so switching style never moves anything.
crop is the full image because both PNGs are already cut to the inner field boundary.
calibrated stays false: it marks a human eyeball check in the browser, not the CAD measurement.
